tokens.v: The subject is an opaque brushed-steel cylinder - disregard the faceted-glass-bottle, glass-refraction and lettering-ban clauses. Stand it on wet blue-black slate, roller uncapped, a viscous amber bead necking off the steel tip into a filament that has just kissed the pool below, the pool throwing one hard elongated caustic across the stone. FERNWEG sits hand-stamped small in the kraft band, ink sunk into the fibre, the band dark, translucent where oil wicked up its lower edge. 100mm at f/4 at slab height; a soft ridge of slate crosses the bottom edge. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
